title: C_DestroyObject: stale session op-state after key deletion
description: C_DestroyObject marks a key in_use=0 but does not scan sessions to clear sign_key/decrypt_key/verify_key/encrypt_key references to the deleted handle. C_Logout does this cleanup but C_DestroyObject does not. A session that called C_SignInit before the key was deleted will hold a stale handle; its next C_Sign call will either key_get a now-deleted object or dereference freed memory. PKCS#11 2.40 sec.11.10 requires this cleanup.
